name: Ashwall InfoShadow Broker's Complete Set
description:
The info broker's full underworld look: a slim-cut collarless shirt in deep plum shot-silk — understated wealth, no logos — beneath a structured mid-length coat in matte charcoal wool-synth with hidden interior panels for data storage media and slim weapons. Trousers are tailored dark slate with a subtle iridescent weave visible only at close range. Shoes are soft-soled, pointed-toe oxfords in black bioskin — silent on tile and concrete alike.

Accessories are deliberate: one matte-chrome data-link bracelet on the left wrist, a minimal neural port ring at the temple, and a narrow-brim hat in pressed felt that obscures the face on overhead surveillance. No visible aug hardware, though the coat accommodates a spinal rig under the back panel.
functionality: Hidden interior coat panels for data storage and slim weapons, spinal rig channel under back panel, soft bioskin soles for near-silent movement, neural port integration at temple ring, surveillance-obscuring hat brim angle.
what_it_says: I know things you need, I dress like I don't need you, and neither of those facts is an accident.
story_hooks: The interior panel of the coat contains a data chip that hasn't been opened in three years — the broker doesn't know who planted it.
The bioskin oxfords are traceable to a Spire tannery that only sells to Tier 5 clients; how the broker got them is its own story.
Someone in the same hat and coat configuration was photographed at two separate crime scenes six months apart — different person, same outfit.

Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purposefully anonymous silhouette designed for moving through corpo networks and street underworld simultaneously. The plum shirt provides subtle chromatic depth without drawing attention, while the charcoal coat creates a clean vertical line. The narrow-brim hat and pointed oxfords complete an intentionally forgettable profile—the kind of person security cameras log but never remember.
physical_description.fit: Slim and tailored throughout, with strategic ease in the coat's shoulders to accommodate concealed hardware. Trousers have a precise, almost surgical fit at the hips and thighs, tapering cleanly to the ankles. The coat sits mid-thigh, structured but not rigid, allowing silent movement.
physical_description.primary_material: Collarless shirt: deep plum shot-silk (iridescent finish, matte base). Coat: matte charcoal wool-synth blend with ballistic weave reinforcement. Trousers: treated dark slate composite with iridescent synthetic undertones. Shoes: bioskin (synthetic leather, pressure-sensitive, dampening)
physical_description.texture: Shot-silk produces a liquid visual depth—colors shift subtly with movement. Coat exterior is matte, almost non-reflective; interior lining is smooth, dense microweave for data-storage panel integration. Trousers show minimal texture on initial viewing; iridescence only emerges at oblique angles. Bioskin shoes are soft to touch, almost supple, with zero acoustic signature on hard surfaces.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant: deep plum (shirt) and matte charcoal (coat). Accent: dark slate (trousers) with buried iridescent weave barely visible in certain light. Black bioskin shoes ground the palette. Matte-chrome hardware (bracelet, ring) provides the only metallic element—deliberately subdued, industrial.
physical_description.closures: Coat: flush magnetic snaps along center front, positioned to be imperceptible when fastened. Hidden interior magnetic locks on data-storage panels. Shirt: friction-fit seams (seamless construction). Trousers: discrete magnetic side-zip at inseam. Shoes: soft elastic collar, no visible fastening.
distinctive_features: Hidden interior panels (coat) lined with magnetic retention strips for data-storage media and slim weapon magazines
Spinal-rig accommodation: reinforced back panel with concealed flex-seams and internal support structure
No visible branding, logos, or maker's marks anywhere on the garment—pure function aesthetic
Shot-silk shirt provides subtle light-refractive properties without reflective glow, minimizing biometric scanning interference
Narrow-brim hat (pressed felt) designed to obscure facial geometry from overhead surveillance angles
Bioskin shoes engineered for silent movement: pressure-dampening sole, near-zero echo on tile/concrete
Iridescent weave in trousers visible only at close range or oblique angles—allows wearer to read their own position in reflections without being obviously augmented
physical_description.tier_indicator: High-functioning Tier 3 with Tier 1 discretion styling. This is not expensive by corpo standards, but it is *precision*. The lack of logos and the deliberate subtlety signal someone operating between worlds—not wealthy enough to advertise wealth, but sophisticated enough to understand that invisibility is the ultimate luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: Information broker. Someone who moves through encrypted networks and shadowed streets with equal fluency. The complete absence of corporate signaling suggests independence from any single faction—this person trades in neutral currency (data, favors, secrets). The ergonomic concealment and surveillance-evasion design speak to a life lived partially outside official monitoring.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn pristine but with an intentional 'lived-in' awareness—clothes this carefully considered never look brand-new. The shot-silk develops soft creases at the elbows and shoulders from repeated wear. The bioskin shoes show faint scuff patterns on the heel from concrete contact. The hat's brim holds a subtle curve from being worn consistently. Everything else remains immaculate: no fraying, no stains, no visible wear on seams or hardware. This is someone who maintains their operational disguise with obsessive care.

image_prompt: Neo-noir fashion photograph of an androgynous figure in dark plum shot-silk collarless shirt and matte charcoal structured coat, tailored dark slate iridescent trousers, and black bioskin oxfords. Narrow-brim felt hat shadows the face, revealing only sharp jawline and matte-chrome data-link bracelet on wrist. Moody overhead lighting casts geometric shadows across the coat's interior panels (subtle glimpse of magnetic storage hardware visible). Urban backdrop: rain-slicked concrete, flickering neon reflection in distant glass, overhead surveillance camera edge-of-frame. Pose: standing profile, hand adjusting hat brim, suggesting deliberate surveillance evasion. Matte finishes dominate; minimal reflectivity throughout. Aesthetic: information operative, noir-adjacent, wealthy-ghost working-class. --ar 2:3 --v 6
